name: ruchanimbalkar/JavaProjectsBasicEmailApp
description: Scenario: You are an IT Support Administrator Specialist and are charged with the task of creating email accounts for new hires. Your application should do the following:  Generate an email with the following syntax: firstname.lastname@department.company.com  Determine the department (sales, development, accounting), if none leave blank  Generate a random String for a password  Have set methods to change the password, set the mailbox capacity, and define an alternate email address  Have get methods to display the name, email, and mailbox capacity.
